summary.done: Fixed 60Hz accumulator loop scaffold: index.html + main.js (960x540 logical space, dpr-aware 16:9 letterbox fit, GAME_SCALE knob) plus systems/update.js + systems/render.js drawing a moving test box. Verified headlessly: clean module load, stable loop, correct transform math, live resize, uniform upscale.
summary.decisions: GAME_SCALE is module-level mutable state behind an accessor (setGameScale/getGameScale, exposed on window) rather than a plain exported const.
summary.tradeoffs: ESM `export let` bindings can't be reassigned externally — use an accessor for tunable knobs. Test-box motion uses wall-clock time (visual only); real entities will use accumulated sim time.
summary.lessons_learned: Headless DOM-stub smoke tests in node verify loop/scaling math without a browser.

summary.done: Entity base class with full §3 fields (position, velocity, gravity, facing, mirrorX/Y, rotation, scale, weight, anim, layer, box, alive, debugColor). worldBox() computes offset AABB; syncMirror() derives mirrorX from facing; update(dt) integrates gravity with MAX_FALL_SPEED clamp; draw(ctx) applies full transform pipeline. consts.js (GRAVITY, MAX_FALL_SPEED, LAYER bitmask) + view.js leaf module. Test entity falls+bounces.
summary.decisions: view.js split out as a true leaf module holding VIEW_W/VIEW_H.
summary.tradeoffs: Circular import (main.js <-> systems) put VIEW_W/H in TDZ at load and killed the loop; a leaf module breaks the cycle cleanly. Bounce formula had to use raw box offsets, not worldBox() result.
summary.lessons_learned: A shared-constants leaf module prevents circular-import TDZ crashes under ESM.

summary.done: CollisionWorld with spatial-hash broadphase (configurable cell size, default 64px), aabbOverlap (strict; touching edges=false), resolve() minimum-penetration-axis correction (no pass-through), and declarative COLLISION_RULES ({a,b,action} array). masksInteract precompiles RULE_PAIRS. Integration: WASD hero vs 4 solid platforms, F3 debug toggle.
summary.decisions: resolve() recomputes worldBox() after each axis push to avoid stale-reference bugs.
summary.tradeoffs: Rule-based pair gate (not if-chains) means a new interaction is one line. Tie-break on equal penetration resolves X first.
summary.lessons_learned: 200 scattered entities built only 266 hash cells vs ~19,900 theoretical pairs — broadphase scales. 0 penetration over a 30s scripted run.

summary.done: Camera class: hero-follow with facing look-ahead (+80px), clamped to [0, levelLength-VIEW_W], lockTo/unlock for boss arena (y stays 0). Render applies ctx.translate(-cam.x,-cam.y) before world draw. Full §16 debug overlay (F3): orange=SOLID, green=HERO, red=ENEMY, blue=PICKUP, pink=PROJ. Test scene extended to 3000px with placeholder enemies/projectiles/pickups.
summary.decisions: Direct follow (no lerp) — acceptable per design note 'direct is fine for v1'.
summary.tradeoffs: Camera translate wrapped in save/restore so the DEBUG ON hint draws in viewport space, not scrolled.
summary.lessons_learned: Clamping verified at both edges; world scrolls once hero passes half-screen.

summary.done: Anim controller: frames[], speed (ms/frame), loop, float index i, done flag. tick(dt) advances frame (wraps for loop, clamps+done for one-shot); pickFrame(n) overrides; reset(); draw(ctx,entity) draws current frame at origin. Transform lives on Entity per §11 — Anim only picks which frame. Hero cycles 5 colored frames (loop); enemy plays 3-frame one-shot.
summary.decisions: Anim.draw() assumes the caller already applied the transform.
summary.tradeoffs: Double-transform bug: Entity.draw() applied translate/mirror/rotate/scale then called anim.draw() which repeated it, compounding transforms and pushing sprites off-screen. Fixed by removing the transform block from Anim.draw().
summary.lessons_learned: Keep transform ownership in exactly one place (Entity); the anim controller must never re-apply it.

summary.done: Hero extends Entity wrapping a hero def. Run (direct velocity, responsive), jump (impulse=-stats.jump, coyote 0.08s, input buffer 0.12s, variable height via early-release cut), crouch (swaps to offset crouchBox, bh 48->28.8, feet planted), slide (speed*1.5 while crouching+moving), facing/mirrorX synced, ground friction x0.85, gravity+MAX_FALL_SPEED clamp. heroDefs.js: Scarlet (fast/high jump) + Balthazar (slow/strong melee). Input: WASD/arrows move, Space/W/Up jump, S/Down crouch.
summary.decisions: Coyote time + jump buffering added for feel beyond the literal spec.
summary.tradeoffs: Direct velocity assignment (no accel ramp) keeps input feeling instant; friction only when no horizontal input.
summary.lessons_learned: Offset-box crouch shrink validates the collision model — box visibly shortens in F3 overlay.

summary.done: State machine skeleton: S enum (HOME/SELECT/PLAY/PAUSE/OVER/WIN), centralized TRANSITIONS map matching design §1, canTransition/tryTransition, onTransition(fn) subscriber hook. Zero rendering imports. Physics gated behind getState()===S.PLAY in update loop. Test overlay shows state name + hint when not in PLAY.
summary.decisions: onTransition subscriber hook lets Milestone 8 wire screen reset/teardown without touching this module.
summary.tradeoffs: Kept deliberately thin — no visual coupling; screens plug in later by reading getState()/subscribing.
summary.lessons_learned: 42-assertion node test: all 6 states, 11 valid edges pass, 12 invalid edges rejected.

summary.done: Projectile (extends Entity, gravity=0, 2s lifetime, 600px/s) + object Pool (64 slots, zero allocation under sustained fire). 8-direction aim from WASD/arrow input (Contra-style). G-key auto-fire with projectile_freq cooldown, ammo decrement, no fire at 0. Friendly-fire off by construction (no PROJ_ALLY×HERO rule). Test targets HP=20 destroyed on hit.
summary.decisions: aimFromInput maps every WASD/arrow combo to a distinct dir index; no directional input falls back to facing.
summary.tradeoffs: Pool.spawn reuses inactive slots via Object.assign — no GC pressure. Lifetime cull at exactly 2s + off-screen cull.
summary.lessons_learned: 29 unit assertions pass (all 8 direction velocities, pool reuse, exhausted-pool soft cap, 100-shot sustained fire).

summary.done: Central damage() in damage.js: defense mitigation (min 1), telemetry (hitsLanded/damageDealt byMethod/byEnemy), death flag — all combat funnels through it. Hero melee: J key, 5-frame swing (windup->active->recovery), hitbox only on frame 3, 0.4s cooldown. meleeHitboxWorld: 40x40 box in facing direction, null outside active frame. applyMeleeDamage uses per-swing hit set. Enemy hit-flash timer. F3 draws yellow melee hitbox.
summary.decisions: Barrel/object HP kept local to GameObj.hit() (victim has no stat sheet); explosion AoE still routes through damage().
summary.tradeoffs: Active-frame-only damage window means windup/recovery deal nothing — validated by frame gating.
summary.lessons_learned: Node tests: damage math, min-1 floor, dead-target guard, death flag, melee frame gating, facing mirror, cooldown block.

summary.done: Enemy base class: type, stats, hp, aiState, aggroRadius, hitFlash, death pipeline (deathTimer->fading->alive=false). takeDamage() routes through central damage(), triggers die() on lethal hit. Jester AI: idle->chase (within 300px)->attack (whip <60px); whip 0.4s with timed active window, 1.5s cooldown. Contact damage ENEMY×HERO drains hero energy. Death: fade, sparkle particles, coin drop. Particles module (pooled, capped ~50). F3: aggro circle + AI state label.
summary.decisions: Whip uses a time-based active window (WHIP_ACTIVE_FRAC) rather than a single frame — reads better.
summary.tradeoffs: Death pipeline owned by Enemy base so all enemies reuse it; coin drop driven by coinDrop config.
summary.lessons_learned: Proves the AI contract (idle/chase/attack) that the other 5 enemies inherit in 5.1.

summary.done: GameObj base (SOLID layer, HP pool, hitFlash, explosive flag, explodeRadius). Barrel (HP 60, radius 120) + CoinBarrel (no AoE, coin burst). Thorns/melee chip HP; bomb one-shots; no break on touch (latched `destroyed`). Explosion: center-to-center circular AoE via central damage() — damages enemies AND hero within radius. PROJ_ALLY×SOLID rule added. VFX: 12-15 orange/red particles + eased screen shake. F3: barrel HP bars + magenta AoE rings.
summary.decisions: Explosion math kept pure (explodeBarrel/withinRadius/centerOf) for unit testing without a DOM.
summary.tradeoffs: Self-damage (hero hurt by own barrel blast) is intentional risk/reward per design.
summary.lessons_learned: 26 object + 3 integration assertions pass; bomb=999 one-shots, thorns need exactly 6 hits (10x6=60).

summary.done: Coin class: per-type weight (bronze 0.8, silver 1.0, gold 1.3), value (10/25/50). Gravity scaled by weight (gold falls faster). Bounce restitution 0.4 + friction, settles when vy<20. Coin-barrel burst spawns 4-6 mixed coins with random upward velocity. Collection on hero touch increments coins + stats.coinsCollected. 1up every 100 coins. Visual spin + pickup sparkle. Cap ~30 active coins.
summary.decisions: Per-type weight creates visible bounce differences (named design requirement).
summary.tradeoffs: Coins settle within ~5s (restitution decay) — not infinite bouncing.
summary.lessons_learned: Node test confirms gold falls faster than bronze and coins come to rest on the ground plane.

summary.done: Powerup class: 8 types (ammo, invincibility, special, rapid, shield, clear, energy, oneUp) as pure apply(hero,context) functions. Collection latched, applies effect, telemetry, sparkle + floating text. Checkpoint (non-solid) trigger stores {x,y} on hero.checkpoint, latches. 8 powerups + 4 checkpoints (1-1..1-4) placed along 6400px level. Invincibility: timed no-damage + fast blink. Rapid: fire rate x2. Clear: kills on-screen enemies. F3: type labels + checkpoint IDs.
summary.decisions: apply() takes a context param (enemies list etc.) so effects like 'clear' reach game state without global coupling.
summary.tradeoffs: Each effect is a pure function — unit-testable in node without a DOM.
summary.lessons_learned: 27 assertions cover every effect, invincibility timer=5, checkpoint latch + restart position, collection latch + telemetry.

summary.done: Five enemy AIs, each a small isolated state machine inheriting Enemy: VineHound (fast chaser speed 180, lunges <50px), Violetta (paces, shoots every 2s in LOS, melee <40px), JackOLantern (rolling bomb HP 30, explodes <80px or 3s timer, AoE 80px, destructible), BorisLoon (flyer gravity=0, sine-wave hover ±30px, dives when hero below, fires downward), BorisLoonBaby (smaller w×0.6, faster ×1.5, HP 15). All inherit Enemy cleanly.
summary.decisions: Flyers set gravity=0; grounders use GRAVITY — property-driven, not per-class branches.
summary.tradeoffs: BorisLoon constructor takes (def,x,y); factories makeBoris/makeBorisBaby wrap it. Enemies lacking idle reuse first walk frame statically.
summary.lessons_learned: All 5 instantiate and tick their AI without error; distinct speeds/attack patterns confirmed.

summary.done: Death sequence: energy 0 -> skull 💀 sine-wave float + fade (1.5s). Life loss, respawn at last checkpoint with full energy + 1s i-frames. Lives exhausted -> GAMEOVER. Game Over overlay: score, stats, Retry/Continue/Quit. Continue costs 1000 coins, max 3/run, restores at checkpoint. Retry restarts at level start, full energy, lives reset to 3. Input R/C/Q during gameover.
summary.decisions: I-frames on respawn (1s) prevent instant re-death at the checkpoint.
summary.tradeoffs: Skull effect is a simple text sprite with sine offset + fading alpha — no sprite asset needed.
summary.lessons_learned: Death/respawn flow verified: dying flag, life decrement, checkpoint respawn, energy restore.

summary.done: LEVELS[0] Big Top: 8000px, elephant boss, 4 checkpoints, 8 platforms. Spawn budget: 26 enemies (6 types), 8 barrels, 4 coin barrels, 13 powerups. generateLevel() rogue spawner with min-spacing (100px) random placement. No loose coins (only from barrel bursts + enemy drops). Boss arena (last 500px) + hero start zone (first 500px) kept clear. All items instantiated as real objects. Integrated into update.js.
summary.decisions: MIN_SPACING reduced 200->100px so the full budget fits in the ~7000px spawnable range.
summary.tradeoffs: Powerups spawned as a single batch (not per-type) to maximize available space; random placement can still come up 1-2 short on rare runs (acceptable for a rogue layout).
summary.lessons_learned: Enemies/barrels/coinBarrels always hit exact counts; powerups 11-13/13 across runs. Replayable (different layout each load).

summary.done: Elephant boss: HP 500, phase machine (idle->charge->stomp->trunk_blast). Camera lock to arena when hero within trigger radius. Escalation: phases speed up as HP drops (up to 1.5x). Weak point: head/trunk zone takes 1.5x damage (requires hitPos). Trunk blast fires 3 enemy projectiles in a fan. Charge runs across arena. Stomp telegraphed shake + shockwave window. Contact damage via HERO×BOSS rule. Death reuses Enemy pipeline; onDeath() triggers WIN. F3: phase label, HP bar, weak-point box.
summary.decisions: Weak-point bonus requires a hitPos argument — base hits take normal damage.
summary.tradeoffs: Escalation multiplier (1.0 + (1-hpFrac)*0.5) makes the fight harder as the boss weakens.
summary.lessons_learned: Phase cycling, weak-point math, and death->win transition verified in node.

summary.done: Effects module: vignette (red edge glow on hero damage, decays 0.5s), screenFlash (white flash on big explosions, decays 0.15s). spawnHitSparkles (3-5 red), spawnDeathSparkle (sprite-sized), spawnPickupPop (colored ring), spawnExplosion (12+ warm particles scaled to AoE). Enemy shake ±3px during hitFlash (no extra timer). All wired: hero damage, proj hits, melee, barrel/bomb explosion, enemy death, powerup pickup. Reuses pooled particle system.
summary.decisions: Shake rides the existing hitFlash timer instead of a second clock.
summary.tradeoffs: All spawners reuse the pooled particle system — zero allocation in the hot path.
summary.lessons_learned: 20 assertions cover decay rates, clamping, spawn counts/sizing, shake bounds, reset.

summary.done: Debug module: toggle (F1), god mode, timeScale (slow-mo/freeze), selected entity, event log ring buffer (50). Free-spawn keys 1-9 (all enemies, barrels, coin barrels, powerups). God mode (G): invincible + infinite ammo. Slow-mo cycle (T): 1x->0.5x->0.25x->freeze->1x. Hero swap (Y). AI state force + aggro radius circle + facing arrow + state label. Anim scrubber (step frames, overlay collision box). Live stats HUD. Event log display (L). initSpawnTable(deps) populates factories at load.
summary.decisions: Everything behind if(Debug.enabled) for zero-cost normal play.
summary.tradeoffs: Keyboard-driven (no complex UI) — prioritizes iteration speed over polish, per design.
summary.lessons_learned: Spawn table populated by initSpawnTable at game load; empty until then (expected).

summary.done: stats.js: createStats() with full §4.1 telemetry structure. dumpStats(): console group + downloadable JSON on win/gameover. calculateScore(): enemies×100, boss×1000, coins×10, barrels×50/75, checkpoints×25. timePlayed + distanceTraveled tracked per frame during PLAY. All counters wired: kills by type, damage by method/enemy, hits taken by source, powerups by type, barrels by type, coins by type. Score shown on gameover/win.
summary.decisions: dumpStats produces both a readable console group and a downloadable JSON blob.
summary.tradeoffs: Score formula is a single tunable function feeding HUD + end screens.
summary.lessons_learned: Score calc verified: 5 jester + boss + 50 coins + 3 barrels + 4 checkpoints = 2250.

summary.done: Home: parallax bigtop scene (3 layers at different speeds), logo centered, blinking 'PRESS ENTER'. Select: two hero panels (Scarlet/Balthazar) with art, name, special label; gold border on focused panel, ←/→ cycle, Enter confirms. Hero selection drives gameplay via onTransition hook (correct stats/special). loadImages() preloads assets on page load. Graceful fallback if images not loaded. Replaced skeleton state overlay.
summary.decisions: Later rewritten with correct layering: 0.75x cover-fit, stage void-mask (alpha-zero near-black top so tent bleeds through), crowd bottom-anchored, Scarlet 80% height pendulum on left, bigtop pans L->R (circular tent), stage+crowd R->L.
summary.tradeoffs: Stage image is fully opaque — its black top would cover the elephant without the void-mask.
summary.lessons_learned: 18 assertions + browser screenshot confirm no stretching, correct layer order, visible elephant/tiger/crowd/Scarlet.

summary.done: Pause: semi-transparent overlay on frozen game, Resume/Retry/Quit. Game Over: score + kills + coins, Retry/Continue(3, 1000 coins)/Quit. Win: VICTORY banner, full §4.1 stats summary, Play Again/Quit. All wired to state machine transitions. Continue deducts coins, restores at checkpoint with full energy. Game world visible behind pause (dimmed).
summary.decisions: Reuse calculateScore from stats.js for consistent scoring across screens.
summary.tradeoffs: Continue gated on continuesUsed<3 AND coins>=1000; disabled option rendered dimmed.
summary.lessons_learned: All three screens expose draw+onKey; transitions follow valid state-machine paths.

summary.done: drawHUD(ctx,hero,camera,levelDef) in viewport space: energy bar (red fill + cyan shield overlay, 200x16 top-left), ammo (thorn) + special ammo with hero-specific icons (saw/bomb), coins + lives top-right, hero portrait (32x32 lazy-loaded from assets/heroes/), checkpoint progress line (track + orange markers 1-1..1-4 + green hero dot with triangle pointer, clamped to level length). Drawn after camera restore, PLAY state only.
summary.decisions: Portrait lazy-loaded and cached per hero id; falls back to a colored box + initial before assets load.
summary.tradeoffs: Functional-first (readable bars/numbers); depends only on player state so it stubs early and polishes late.
summary.lessons_learned: 12 assertions: energy fill/clamp, shield overlay, live ammo/special/coins/lives, 4 checkpoint marker positions, hero marker clamping, PLAY-state gate.
